story: Odomankoma, the creator, made the universe—called simply "the Thing." He also created life, and he created death (Owuo). Mysteriously, Odomankoma himself was later killed by Owuo, the very death he had created. After his death, life itself returned to awaken him. He revived as a spirit called Kra, and from then on lived on as the soul of Nyankopon, becoming Nyankopon's personality and successor. Now embodied as this soul, Odomankoma struggled again with Owuo, managing to withstand Owuo's venom. Odomankoma then forced Owuo to eat poison, achieving a total triumph over him. However, despite being defeated, Owuo remained alive and continued to cause the death of mortals. Odomankoma communicates through a sacred drum, and has an appointed drummer, said to be the most knowledgeable person regarding traditional history. Odomankoma is represented by two animals: the vulture and the spider. In some tellings, the trickster spider Ananse advised Odomankoma in the creation of humans; in other tellings, Ananse is simply another name for Odomankoma himself.
